data.name: The Golden Gate Bridge Bike Tour
data.short_name: SF The Golden Gate Bridge Bike Tour
data.headline: All Ages! • 3 Hours
data.description:
#Duration

3 Hours

#About

Explore San Francisco - the City by the Bay with its rolling hills and never ending water views - with Unlimited Biking on a beautiful bike ride along the city’s stunning waterfront, across the Golden Gate Bridge, towards the quaint coastal community of Sausalito. 

Tours depart daily at 10am from Unlimited Biking’s storefront on 887 Beach Street, at the foot of Ghirardelli Square, and last for 3 hours. To ensure a personalized guest experience, each tour will be held in a small-group format of no more than 15 guests. 

After departing from Ghirardelli Square at the western end of Fisherman’s Wharf, guests will bike through the green hillside of Fort Mason, the Marina District, through Crissy Fields, up to and across the Golden Gate Bridge, and then down the Marin Headlands into Sausalito. There, guests can either stay to explore Sausalito on their own, or take the ferry back to San Francisco. Guests on this small-group bike tour will be fitted with state-of-the-art Cannondale bikes. For a nominal fee, guests can also upgrade to e-bikes.
 
*All guests must be able to ride their own bicycles. Attachments such as double trailers and tagalong bikes are not permitted for the safety of the group.*
data.cancellation_notes:
**Bike Tour Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your tour. 

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the tour, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid towards bike rentals that will never expire!

In the event of inclement weather, our team will contact you in advance for any tour cancellations.

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
We are excited to have you join our amazing tour guides on an adventure over San Francisco's most iconic bridge! This tour is approximately 3 hours long and covers many of SF's best sights, such as The Golden Gate Bridge, Sausalito and much more!

Please try to arrive 10-15 minutes before your tour's starting time to check in with our team and meet your guide! Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!
Please keep in mind that this tour ends in Sausalito. From there, you can ride back or take the Blue and Gold Ferry back to Fisherman’s Wharf!

**Know Before You Go:**

- All children must be *one year or older* to be on any bike/bike attachments for the child's own safety.
- Any riders who are under 18 years of age must have an adult present to check in and sign the waiver form in behalf of them. We require a valid identity card upon check in.
- For all our riders' safety, we are not able to accommodate any riders who are 300 pounds and over as this exceeds the weight limit the manufacturer has advised for the bike's build. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we do prioritize your safety during the ride. 

If anything from the list above concerns you or any members of your party, please feel free to reach out to our team by responding to this email. We will get back to you as soon as we can!
